name: Paediatric critical care
description: Paediatric intensive care: clinical practice, outcomes and the questions driving PICU research.
about: Videos here cover intracranial pressure monitoring in severe childhood brain injury, acute liver failure, extubation failure and delays in ventilation weaning. They also describe paediatric ARDS research, the PIVOTAL adaptive platform trial and the Phoenix criteria for sepsis and septic shock.

name: Emergency care
description: Recognising and treating the acutely unwell child, from the emergency department to the ward.
about: The videos look at recognising deterioration, delays in treating status epilepticus, and the national paediatric early warning systems with the SPOT pilot. Others describe point-of-care testing for Group A Streptococcus, oral fluid challenges, a skin conditions guideline and accidental adrenaline auto-injector injuries in children.

name: Neonatology
description: Care of newborn and preterm infants, in hospital and at home.
about: The videos cover bedside laryngeal ultrasound in infants, a pilot of oral antibiotics at home for newborns with suspected early-onset infection, and point-of-care ultrasound. They also describe neonatal brain MRI over 15 years and Neotree, which supports newborn care in low-resource settings.

name: Respiratory
description: Respiratory disease, airway and breathing support in children.
about: Several videos deal with breathing support in PICU, including extubation failure, delays in ventilation weaning, high-flow weaning and personalised ventilation using protein biomarkers and lung ultrasound. Others describe paediatric ARDS, gene therapy in spinal muscular atrophy, sleep-disordered breathing in neuromuscular disorders and asthma outcomes across ethnicity and socioeconomic status.

name: Neurology
description: The developing brain: seizures, brain injury, neuromuscular and neurodevelopmental conditions.
about: Topics include intracranial pressure monitoring in traumatic brain injury, delays in treating status epilepticus, neonatal brain MRI and spinal muscular atrophy. The videos also describe sleep-disordered breathing in neuromuscular disorders, virtual reality simulation for autism spectrum disorder, ADHD and the development of cognitive empathy in children with neurological disorders.

name: Mental health
description: Mental health and emotional wellbeing of children and young people.
about: The videos cover rising mental health admissions to general paediatric wards, including the MAP study, and patterns among girls aged 11 to 15 and those with eating disorders. They also describe AI tools for earlier detection of ADHD and depression and the development of cognitive empathy in neurodiverse profiles.

name: Infection
description: Infectious disease in childhood, including sepsis, vaccination and the use of antibiotics.
about: The videos cover the Phoenix criteria for sepsis and septic shock, oral antibiotics for newborns with suspected early-onset infection and point-of-care testing for Group A Streptococcus. They also describe TB disease in children, global vaccination in low- and middle-income countries and why some families choose not to vaccinate.

name: Allergy
description: Allergy in children and young people.
about: The videos describe a service evaluation of asthma and allergy outcomes across ethnicity and socioeconomic status, and antibiotic allergy documentation and referral for delabelling of children with a low-risk allergy label.

name: Immunology
description: The immune system and immune disorders in childhood.

name: Oncology
description: Childhood cancer.
about: The videos cover long-term PICANet trends in oncology admissions to intensive care, including unplanned admissions by time of day. They also describe paired whole genome sequencing for suspected childhood cancer, the two-week standard for suspected bone and soft tissue tumours and PICC line complications in adolescent Hodgkin's lymphoma.

name: Haematology
description: Blood disorders in children and young people.
about: Covers how adherence to hydroxycarbamide is measured in children with sickle cell disease, comparing patient-reported adherence with laboratory measures.

name: Gastroenterology
description: Gut, liver and nutritional care for children.
about: The videos look at acute liver failure and extracorporeal therapies, the GASTRIC-PICU trial of routine gastric residual monitoring during enteral feeding, and oral fluid challenges. They also describe coeliac disease diagnosis through non-biopsy pathways and the IgA-TTG threshold, and FibroScan in children with MASLD.

name: Genetics and rare disease
description: Genomics, rare and metabolic conditions, and the therapies changing their course.
about: The videos cover burosumab for X-linked hypophosphataemia and how to recognise the condition, along with gene therapy for spinal muscular atrophy type 1. They also describe paired whole genome sequencing for suspected childhood cancer, genomic testing in underserved communities and surveillance of rare childhood diseases.

name: Medicines and prescribing
description: Safe, effective and sustainable use of medicines for children.
about: The videos cover standardising medicine labels, liquid medicine strengths and IV infusion concentrations, with smart pumps and ready-made syringes. Other subjects include burosumab, buccal oxycodone in paediatric palliative care, hydroxycarbamide, biologic therapies, the carbon footprint of medicines and animated medicine information for children.

name: Surgery
description: Surgical care, anaesthesia, major trauma and recovery.
about: The videos cover major trauma in adolescents, including the case for combining adult and paediatric expertise, safeguarding, psychosocial support, family involvement and recovery. They also describe an audit of postoperative care after elective spinal surgery and the case for a paediatric high dependency unit.

name: Dermatology
description: Skin conditions in children and young people.
about: The videos describe a skin conditions guideline for a children's A&E department, with escalation pathways and diverse images, and skin problems as a complication of biologic therapies, including joint work with dermatologists.

name: Adolescent health
description: Young people's health and the move from children's to adult services.
about: The videos cover adult critical care services that receive young people after PICU, transition to adult services for young people with complex conditions, and developmentally appropriate healthcare across a regional network. Others describe adolescent major trauma and child health research investment across health, education and social care.

name: Patient safety and quality improvement
description: Making care safer and better: standards, early warning systems and improvement projects.
about: The videos cover escalation and early warning, including Martha's Rule, Ryan's Rule and paediatric early warning systems. Others examine standardised medicine labels, liquid medicine strengths and IV infusions, LocSSIPs for invasive procedures, a lumbar puncture toolkit and low-value care in PICU, along with audits of ventilation weaning and high-flow weaning.

name: Research and clinical trials
description: How paediatric evidence is built: trials, surveillance, research networks and capacity.
about: The videos cover randomised trials and adaptive platform trials such as PIVOTAL and GASTRIC-PICU, along with precision medicine using biomarkers. They also describe PICANet data, surveillance of rare childhood diseases, patient and public involvement, and building research capacity through a Trainee Research Network and Assistant Research Practitioners.

name: Data, digital and AI
description: Data science, digital tools and artificial intelligence in child health.
about: The videos cover PICU data repositories and decision-support tools, population-level data such as PICANet, and AI tools that analyse video, audio and questionnaires to detect ADHD and depression. They also describe virtual reality simulation for autism spectrum disorder, animated medicine information with QR codes on pharmacy labels and the real-time data used by Neotree.

name: Education and training
description: Teaching, simulation and learning for the child health workforce and students.
about: The videos cover bedside resuscitation teaching, simulation-based Registrar Ready days, virtual reality simulation for autism spectrum disorder and the PICUlearn online learning community. Others describe educator provision in paediatric critical care, point-of-care ultrasound and its learning pathway, patient safety in medical training and school sessions such as the Dr Me Project.

name: Workforce and wellbeing
description: Careers, staffing, teamwork and the wellbeing of people who care for children.
about: The videos cover staff wellbeing after a major incident, nursing careers in PICU, the value of critical-care nursing and the contribution of allied health professionals. They also describe educator roles, rapid review clinics, hospital at home, trainee involvement in research and Registrar Ready days for the tier 2 rota.

name: Nursing and allied health
description: Perspectives from nurses, pharmacists, therapists and other allied health professionals.
about: The videos cover the contribution of allied health professionals to paediatric critical care, bedside laryngeal ultrasound tested by speech and language therapists, and career paths for PICU nurses. They also describe evidence gaps on registered nursing staffing and the role of Assistant Research Practitioners in emergency research.

name: Children, young people and families
description: Lived experience, co-production and the voices of children, young people and parents.
about: The videos cover patient and public involvement in critical-care research, including the lived experience of a parent and a former PICU patient, and co-production with young people. Others describe Project AEGIS for children seeking asylum, CoLab for children with medical complexity, Medicines for Children information, Ryan's Rule and why some families choose not to vaccinate.

name: Health equity and global child health
description: Inequalities, underserved communities and child health around the world.
about: The videos cover equitable access to Martha's Rule, children and young people seeking asylum, and underserved communities in genomic testing. Others describe armed conflict and healthcare consultations in Northwest Syria, global vaccination in low- and middle-income countries, asthma outcomes across ethnicity, ethnic minority children with ADHD and newborn care in low-resource settings.

name: Safeguarding, ethics and law
description: Child protection, ethical decisions and the legal framework around children's care.
about: The videos cover how courts approach serious medical-treatment cases involving children, including best interests, and practical preparation for giving evidence in court. They also describe medical photography in child protection examinations, safeguarding in adolescent trauma care and a shared strategy for paediatric and neonatal organ donation.

name: Policy and advocacy
description: Strategy, policy and advocacy for children's health services.
about: The videos cover child health strategy and advocacy, including a Wales manifesto ahead of the 2026 Senedd elections and national research priorities such as obesity and mental health. They also describe a Joint Medicines Committee for paediatric medicines, a shared strategy for paediatric and neonatal organ donation, and how surveillance studies have shaped screening, policy and safety initiatives.
